title: Cutover Field Journal
content:
Purpose: personal field notes for release cutover. Lightweight, action-oriented, meant to live on my laptop and get copied into shared postmortem later. Use as canonical checklist for zero-hour and +2h follow-ups.

CONTEXT:
- Release: v3.8.1 (hotfix bundle + streaming timeout fix)
- Cutover owner: Ethan Z. (me)
- Window: 02:00–03:00 UTC (low traffic)
- Risk: DB migration (index rebuild), config rollout for rate limiter
- Primary oncall: Priya (infra), Carlos (serving)

PRE-CUTOVER (T-48h to T-2h): quick checklist
- [x] Finalize canary metrics and SLO gates (REL-1423)
- [x] Confirm smoke test harness runs locally with staging model
- [x] Backport list locked: PR#9876 (streaming fix), PR#9951 (timeout), small patch for quantization flag
- [x] Notify SRE pager rota for window and escalation path
- [ ] Confirm DB snapshot and retention policy: run test restore into ephemeral cluster (if time)
- [ ] Ensure alert silencing is configured for non-critical noisy alerts (temp silence IDs: SIL-554, SIL-559)

ZERO HOUR (02:00 UTC) — sequence and responsibilities- 01:50 UTC: final sync in #releng-cutover, call "start" when all green- 02:00 UTC: flip feature-gate for rollout (me) — command: ./infra/rollout --env=prod --tag=v3.8.1 --gate=rate-limiter- 02:02 UTC: deploy hotfix PR#9951 to canary pool (Carlos) — monitor CPU and token latency for 5 minutes- 02:10 UTC: run smoke tests (Priya) — smoke script: ./tools/smoke.sh --suite=critical --concurrency=2- 02:20 UTC: observe canary for 15m; if metrics stable, promote to 25% traffic- 02:45 UTC: full rollout via gradual traffic ramp (automation will step 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 3m intervals)- 02:50 UTC: trigger index rebuild job (DB team) — note: rebuild is online but can increase tail latency; watch p95 ops

ESCALATION & ROLLBACK TRIGGERS- Abort and rollback immediately if:  - token latency p95 spikes > 250ms over 5m  - error rate for generation endpoints increases > 0.5% absolute  - DB rebuild causes >2% request timeouts- Rollback command (fast): ./infra/rollout --env=prod --rollback-to-tag=v3.8.0 --force- If rollback fails or partial, flip traffic to Dedicated backup region: infra/failover --to-region=eu-west-1-backup

BACKPORTS & PATCH NOTES (copy this into release notes)- PR#9876: streaming fix — backported from main -> release/3.8.x — CHANGES: improved keepalive, fewer mid-response failures- PR#9951: timeout tuning — small config change to decoder loop; default reduced from 5s -> 2s for idle prompts- quant-flag.patch: enables int8 fallback for certain GPU types, opt-in via env REDWOOD_QUANT_FALLBACK=1

SMOKE TESTS (quick results logging)- smoke-critical: OK (latency median 75ms)- embed-regression: OK- throughput-check: degraded 5% during DB index, expected- manual sample QA: chat response plausibility thumbs-up 6/6

COMMUNICATION TEMPLATES- Slack (start): "Cutover v3.8.1 START at 02:00 UTC. Owners: Ethan (cutover), Priya (infra), Carlos (serving). Runbook: JIRA REL-1423. Post here for status updates. If critical, call +1 on phone."- Slack (successful rollout): "v3.8.1 FULL ROLLOUT COMPLETE — all checks green. Will observe for 60m. Thanks team."- Slack (rollback): "ROLLBACK: v3.8.1 -> v3.8.0 initiated due to p95 spike. Traffic moved to backup region. Triage in #incident-releng."- Customer status email (short): "We deployed a minor fix to the inference service at 02:00 UTC to address streaming timeouts. Services are operating normally; we will follow up if further action is required. — Redwood Inference Ops"

POST-CUTOVER (T+1h, T+24h): follow-ups- +1h: validate metrics window for regressions; capture traces for any anomalies- +2h: create ticket for any minor residuals (label: postcutover)- +24h: schedule short retro with infra and serving to list what went well / surprises- Add to backlog: automated test for DB index tail-latency simulation

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF- Should we increase canary window to 30m for index-heavy releases? Pros: catch regressions. Cons: longer rollback latency.- Reminder: copy the final smoke test output to REL-1423 and paste summary into release notes.- If we hit degraded throughput, check KV cache hit rate and evictions (cache:redis-qk), and whether cache warming job ran.

AD-HOC LOG (live record)- 01:55 UTC: Priya confirmed smoke harness passing in staging- 02:05 UTC: observed canary p95 jump to 180ms -> stabilized at 90ms by 02:08- 02:26 UTC: index rebuild started, p95 temporarily 230ms, error rate stable- 02:50 UTC: promoted to 100% traffic at 02:58 after automated ramp completed- 03:15 UTC: postcutover checks OK, leaving soft silence on non-critical alerts until 06:00 UTC

RETRO ACTION ITEMS (to assign)
- REL-1423: follow up on streaming retries optimization (assignee: Carlos)
- OPS-3310: automate index rebuild impact test and include in preflight (assignee: Priya)
- DOC: add comms templates to handbook (me)

Quick commands & snippets (for copy/paste)- rollout promote: ./infra/rollout --promote --tag=v3.8.1- rollback fast: ./infra/rollout --rollback-to-tag=v3.8.0 --force- smoke script: ./tools/smoke.sh --suite=critical --report=artifact://smoke/v3.8.1

End of field journal entry. Keep this file as ephemeral; move final summary to shared_drives/company/misc/release-archive after the retro.
